opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage participation as a route to substantial earnings, pairing a title about earning 30 million with a claimed return from invested capital. The speaker describes slot costs and connects roughly 8 million in capital with a one cycle result, while directing viewers to contact him for registration guidance, wallet setup, and dollar purchase. The process depends on recruiting two members on the left and right and receiving a bonus from those members, establishing a branching structure in which participation and commissions are tied to recruitment. Although the available evidence does not establish that the stated amounts were realized or guaranteed, and a lower cost starting option is mentioned, the material presents recruitment based participation as a way to pursue the claimed income.
